finding.claim: Bundled VPNBook PPTP password ngzc6a8 (source observed 2026-09-29) became stale after the official provider rotated credentials on 2026-10-05.

decision.claim: Refresh repository data authority only; do not issue a new application release solely for a rotating provider password.
decision.rationale: Windows and Linux Router Gateway refresh paths fetch main/router_gateway/providers.json independently of the application release, and attempt direct live VPNBook refresh when reachable.

prevention: Treat rotating provider credentials as data authority, not immutable application release state.
Provider freshness failures must distinguish upstream/network unavailability from stale bundled data.
Revalidate official rotating credentials at finalization and meaningful maintenance milestones.
exactNextAction: Commit/push data-authority refresh, require CI, merge to main, then refresh installed caches.

regression.liveEndpointInformational: VPN Gate L2TP profile endpoint TCP/443 reachable; full L2TP/IPsec handshake remains UNPROVEN by design.
